alvis-security-audit-v2 2.0.0 Changelog

- Internal skill rename from "alvis-security-audit" to "openclaw-security-audit" for consistency.
- No code or content changes detected in the skill definition or workflow.
- Behavior, audit workflow, and output format remain unchanged from prior version.

openclaw-security-audit v1.0.0

- Initial release, adapted from alvis-security-audit-v2.
- Provides a read-only audit tool targeting OpenClaw/Clawdbot deployments.
- Identifies misconfigurations, network exposures, unsafe skill/tool policies, credential risks, and privilege escalations.
- Generates a clear, actionable terminal audit report with per-check evidence, impact, and fix recommendations.
- Never modifies system state or exfiltrates data; remediation steps are given only upon user request.
